breakdown.description: The setup assumes inviscid flow but then includes viscous friction losses (Darcy–Weisbach).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction between assuming an inviscid flow and then using an equation (Darcy-Weisbach) that calculates pressure drop due to viscous friction. The agent resolved this by explicitly stating, 'The flow must be treated as viscous, and friction must be accounted for,' which directly aligns with the correction made in the ground truth.
